scope: Ascend 950DT GemmW4A8FwdOp: all 98 manifest workload cases (DeepSeek-R1 and Llama-3 70B up/down projections, batch 1 to 4096 rows, and their eight-way tensor-parallel shards). FP8 activations times a signed INT4 weight with a 128-value group scale; the weight is unpacked to the exact FP8 operand the reference contracts. Not a public performance receipt.

campaign.metric: arithmetic mean of raw ffts device execution interval unions
campaign.reason: Task-private protocol adapter: one profiler window carries all 25 calls instead of one window per call. The eviction and the parsed statistic are unchanged; the public default-clock receipt and the host-wide reservation are still unavailable.
campaign.workspace: Task acceptance workspace, kept outside the repository.
campaign.stage_protocol: Each pass is timed with the same window; `forward` is the sum of the three passes, so the stages account for the end-to-end cost.

baseline.reference: This backend's FP8 GEMM on the same shape, same round, same process: identical Cube work, so the ratio isolates the unpack and the scale pass.
baseline.deepgemm: Not measurable in this container. DeepGEMM's Ascend FP8 NT kernel fails to JIT against the installed CANN 9.2.0 inside its own copy.hpp (asc_set_l0c2gm_nz2nd has no matching overload); the same package produced the grouped-GEMM baselines on 2026-10-27, so the failure is in the toolchain pairing rather than in this op.
baseline.vendor_ops: No ACLNN or torch_npu entry point takes FP8 activations. npu_weight_quant_batchmatmul serves A16W4/A16W8 (BF16/FP16 activations), which runs at the BF16 tensor-core rate and is not a like-for-like baseline.

replay.result: 98 of 98 manifest cases verified, source fingerprint unchanged
replay.guard: scripts/npu_guard.py with /dev/davinci0 remapped to /dev/davinci1 for this site
replay.harness_note: The shared input-preservation check compares every input with torch.isclose, which this torch_npu build does not implement for float8_e4m3fn; the replay compares FP8 inputs bitwise through a uint8 view, the same statement for those tensors.
replay.receipt: Task acceptance workspace, kept outside the repository.

verification.tolerances: The shared workload numeric policy through the public runner.

repository_commit_note: e606fe1e is the commit that adds the kernel and the one the numbers were measured from; this provenance record sits on top of it, so the branch head that ships it has a later hash.
